title: Wolframio
description: Wolframio is a streamlined mod pack that boosts Minecraft’s performance and enhances vanilla gameplay. As solid and reliable as tungsten—without the industrial price tag.
body: Wolframio Pack is a streamlined mod pack that boosts Minecraft’s performance and enriches gameplay. Enjoy faster, smoother play with visual enhancements, quality-of-life improvements, and a focus on efficiency and stability. Designed to feel solid and dependable, so you can focus on playing instead of tweaking settings.
